    # Tile each seed patch across its own rectangular zero panel. The seed is

    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):

        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while q:
          a,b=q.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
          for x,y in ((a-1,b),(a+1,b),(a,b-1),(a,b+1)):
            if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and grid[x][y]!=8 and (x,y) not in seen:
              seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
        ink=[(a,b) for a,b in cells if grid[a][b] not in (0,8)]
        if not ink: continue

        # colored pixel in its initial rows (same-size seed tile is evident).
        a=min(x for x,y in ink); b=max(x for x,y in ink)
        x=min(y for x,y in ink); y=max(y for x,y in ink)
        for rr,cc in cells:
          out[rr][cc]=grid[a+(rr-a)%(b-a+1)][x+(cc-x)%(y-x+1)]
